title: 2026 U.S. House of Representatives election for Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District
description: The 2026 election for Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District will decide who represents Milwaukee's northern and western suburbs, including Waukesha, West Bend, Brookfield, and Mequon. Incumbent Republican Rep. Scott Fitzgerald, first elected in 2020, is seeking a fourth term in this safely Republican district (Cook PVI: R+14). Two Democrats, paramedic Ben Steinhoff (the 2024 nominee) and product developer Andrew Beck, are competing in the August 11 primary to challenge Fitzgerald. The primary has not yet concluded, so both Democratic contenders are listed as primary candidates.

candidates.name: Scott Fitzgerald
candidates.summary: Scott Fitzgerald is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District, first elected in 2020. He previously served in the Wisconsin State Senate for 26 years, including as Majority Leader and Minority Leader, and is a retired U.S. Army Reserve Lieutenant Colonel and former newspaper publisher.

candidates.name: Andrew Beck
candidates.summary: Andrew 'Andy' Beck is a Democratic candidate for Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District, running on a platform of lowering costs, creating jobs, and improving healthcare. A product developer and business professional with experience in hospitality, manufacturing, and healthcare, Beck previously ran as a write-in candidate in 2024. He favors compromise and bipartisanship, highlighting proposals for technical school training programs and affordable housing.

candidates.name: Ben Steinhoff
candidates.summary: Ben Steinhoff is a Democratic candidate for Wisconsin's 5th Congressional District, running for the second consecutive cycle after being the 2024 Democratic nominee. He is a paramedic and volunteer firefighter with 12 years of experience as a first responder, including work with UW Med Flight and a children's hospital. Steinhoff emphasizes his non-politician background and positions himself as a working-class advocate focused on healthcare access and public service.

forecast.rationale: This race presents an overwhelming Republican advantage based on fundamentals. Cook PVI R+14 places the 5th District among the most Republican-leaning seats in the country. Incumbent Scott Fitzgerald is a three-term incumbent with 26 years of prior legislative service and strong name recognition. The Democratic primary between Ben Steinhoff (2024 nominee who lost decisively) and Andrew Beck is not yet resolved, leaving the general-election challenger unsettled and without a unified campaign. No published polling exists, which tempers confidence, but the structural landscape — a strong incumbent in a safely Republican district with no Democratic nominee finalized — supports a Safe Republican rating with approximately 97% probability of Republican control. Margin estimate of ~22 points is consistent with the district's baseline partisanship and recent performance.
